'''Huika Siliu''' was the mother of [[Pendra Siliu]], a girl rescued by [[Jyn Erso]] during an attack by the [[Partisans]] in [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on [[Jedha]].

==Biography==
Huika Siliu was a [[human]] [[Gender|woman]] who lived with her husband [[Larn Siliu]] and their daughter [[Pendra Siliu]] in the capital of the desert moon [[Jedha]] in the middle of the border. Before the [[Galactic Civil War]] erupted, Jedha was under control of the [[Galactic Empire]] where the Imperials were stealing the [[Kyber crystal]]s there, which they mined to develop a [[Death Star|new super weapon]]. The resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]] opposed the Empire on Jedha, which always caused unrest.<ref name="Rogue One novel" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Huika and Pendra were present when Saw Gerrera's Partisans attacked a [[stormtrooper]] patrol. During the sudden attack, Huika was separated from her daughter, who stopped in the crossfire and cried loudly. This made her aware of the [[Jyn Erso]], who rushed to the girl's aid and brought her back to her mother. They left the danger zone and at home she told her husband about the selfless stranger. Some time later, Huika was on the road and Larn had to work, which is why he wanted to bring Pendra to her aunt [[Jola]]. He thought about asking Huika again soon to leave the planet for her safety, but for the time being satisfied that she would be home safely in the evening. However, in the course of the city's destruction by the new super weapon, the Death Star, the two were killed before they could leave for Jola.<ref name="Rogue One novel" />
